settings.authorized_apps.origin.first_pa.description: Where an authorized app comes from: the web client of this server.

settings.authorized_apps.origin.user.description: Where an authorized app comes from: a user registered it. {username} is the user's name without the at sign.

settings.authorized_apps.origin.metadata.description: Where an authorized app comes from: it is described by a document at a web address. {host} is the host name of that address.

settings.authorized_apps.origin.dynamic.description: Where an authorized app comes from: it registered itself and nobody vouches for it.

settings.authorized_apps.unverified.defaultMessage: This server has not verified this app.
settings.authorized_apps.unverified.description: Note on every authorized app that is not this server's own: the name and logo are the app's own claims.

settings.authorized_apps.scope.description: Label of the scopes (permissions) the user granted to an authorized app.

settings.authorized_apps.authorized_at.description: Label of when the user first authorized an app.

settings.authorized_apps.last_used.description: Label of when an authorized app last made a request.

settings.authorized_apps.last_used.at.description: When an app was last used. {date} is a date with the hour only, because the server records the time to the hour.

settings.authorized_apps.last_used.never.description: Shown instead of the last use of an authorized app when no use was recorded.

settings.authorized_apps.revoke.description: Button that revokes an authorized app.

settings.authorized_apps.revoke.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms revoking an authorized app. {name} is the app's name.

settings.authorized_apps.revoke.descript.defaultMessage: The app loses access to your account at once. To use it again, you have to allow it again.
settings.authorized_apps.revoke.descript.description: Explanation in the dialog that confirms revoking an authorized app.

settings.authorized_apps.revoke.descript.defaultMessage: This is the web app you are using. Revoking it signs you out of every browser, including this one. You have to sign in again.
settings.authorized_apps.revoke.descript.description: Warning in the dialog that confirms revoking the server's own web app.

settings.authorized_apps.revoke.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog without revoking the app.

settings.authorized_apps.revoke.failed.description: Alert in the dialog when revoking an authorized app failed. {reason} is the error's message.

settings.authorized_apps.revoked.description: Announcement after an authorized app was revoked. {name} is its name.

settings.email_suppression.title.description: Heading of the section of the notification settings that says emails do not reach the user's address; shown only while the address is suppressed.

settings.email_suppression.hard_bounce.defaultMessage: Emails do not reach your address: an email to it bounced, so the server sends you nothing, not even notifications or a password reset email.
settings.email_suppression.hard_bounce.description: Text of that section after a hard bounce: nothing reaches the address.

settings.email_suppression.complaint.defaultMessage: An email from this server was marked as spam, so notification emails are no longer sent to your address. The emails needed to sign in are still sent.
settings.email_suppression.complaint.description: Text of that section after a spam complaint: notification emails are not sent.

settings.email_suppression.since.description: When the suppression started. {since} is a formatted date and time.

settings.email_suppression.hard_bounce.a.defaultMessage: Once your mailbox works, ask for the verification email again. Verifying the address lets the server send email to it again and removes this notice.
settings.email_suppression.hard_bounce.a.description: What to do after a hard bounce: fix the mailbox, then ask for the verification email again.

settings.linked_accounts.title.description: Title of the settings page of linked accounts (accounts at sign-in services, such as an OpenID Connect provider, that the server's administrators set up), and its entry in the settings menu.

settings.linked_accounts.description.defaultMessage: Accounts at these services sign you in instead of your password, and confirm changes to your account. Linking one never shares your posts with the service.
settings.linked_accounts.description.description: Description at the top of the settings page of linked accounts (accounts at sign-in services, such as an OpenID Connect provider, that the server's administrators set up).

settings.linked_accounts.list.title.description: Heading of the list of the user's linked accounts on the settings page of linked accounts (accounts at sign-in services, such as an OpenID Connect provider, that the server's administrators set up).

settings.linked_accounts.empty.defaultMessage: You have not linked any account.
settings.linked_accounts.empty.description: Empty state of the list of linked accounts.

settings.linked_accounts.linked_at.description: When an account was linked, under the service's name. {date} is a formatted date and time.

settings.linked_accounts.unavailable.defaultMessage: This service is turned off for now: the account does not sign you in.
settings.linked_accounts.unavailable.description: Note under a linked account whose service the administrators turned off.

settings.linked_accounts.unlink.description: Button of a linked account that unlinks it, after a dialog.

settings.linked_accounts.unlink.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms unlinking an account. {provider} is the service's name as the administrators wrote it.

settings.linked_accounts.unlink.descript.defaultMessage: You can no longer sign in with that account. You can link it again later.
settings.linked_accounts.unlink.descript.description: Description of the dialog that confirms unlinking an account.

settings.linked_accounts.unlink.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog that confirms unlinking an account, without unlinking it.

settings.linked_accounts.unlink.last.defaultMessage: This is your last way to sign in. Set a password, add a passkey, or link another account first.
settings.linked_accounts.unlink.last.description: Error in the dialog that unlinks an account when the account is the user's last way to sign in.

settings.linked_accounts.unlink.failed.defaultMessage: The account could not be unlinked: {reason}
settings.linked_accounts.unlink.failed.description: Error in the dialog that unlinks an account. {reason} is the server's or the network's reason.

settings.linked_accounts.unlinked.description: Announcement after an account was unlinked. {provider} is the service's name.

settings.linked_accounts.add.title.description: Heading of the section that links an account at a sign-in service.

settings.linked_accounts.add.description.defaultMessage: You sign in at the service, which then sends you back here. An account linked to someone else on this server cannot be linked.
settings.linked_accounts.add.description.description: Description of the section that links an account.

settings.linked_accounts.add.none.defaultMessage: There is no service to link an account at.
settings.linked_accounts.add.none.description: Note in the section that links an account when the server has no service that allows linking, or the user linked every one.

settings.linked_accounts.link.description: Button that starts linking an account at a service. {provider} is the service's name as the administrators wrote it.

settings.linked_accounts.link.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms linking an account. {provider} is the service's name.

settings.linked_accounts.link.descriptio.defaultMessage: Enter your password to continue to {provider}.
settings.linked_accounts.link.descriptio.description: Description of the dialog that links an account, for a user with a password. {provider} is the service's name.

settings.linked_accounts.link.descriptio.defaultMessage: Your browser asks for one of your passkeys, then you continue to {provider}.
settings.linked_accounts.link.descriptio.description: Description of the dialog that links an account, for a user without a password who has passkeys. {provider} is the service's name.

settings.linked_accounts.link.descriptio.defaultMessage: You signed in again with a linked account. Continue to {provider}.
settings.linked_accounts.link.descriptio.description: Description of the dialog that links an account, once the user confirmed with another linked account. {provider} is the service's name.

settings.linked_accounts.link.password.description: Label of the password field in the dialog that links an account.

settings.linked_accounts.link.password.r.description: Error of the empty password field in the dialog that links an account.

settings.linked_accounts.link.wrong_pass.description: Error in the dialog that links an account when the password is wrong.

settings.linked_accounts.link.continue.description: Button of the dialog that links an account: it leaves for the service.

settings.linked_accounts.link.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog that links an account.

settings.linked_accounts.link.failed.defaultMessage: The link could not be started: {reason}
settings.linked_accounts.link.failed.description: Error in the dialog that links an account. {reason} is the server's or the network's reason.

settings.linked_accounts.linked.description: Status at the top of the page after the service sent the user back with the account linked. {provider} is the service's name.

settings.linked_accounts.failed.linked_e.defaultMessage: That account is linked to another user of this server.
settings.linked_accounts.failed.linked_e.description: Alert when the account the user signed in with at the service is linked to another user already.

settings.linked_accounts.failed.already_.defaultMessage: You have already linked an account at that service.
settings.linked_accounts.failed.already_.description: Alert when the user links an account at a service where they already have one linked.

settings.linked_accounts.failed.denied.defaultMessage: That service does not accept the account you signed in with.
settings.linked_accounts.failed.denied.description: Alert when the account at the service does not meet the conditions that the administrators set (such as an organization).

settings.linked_accounts.failed.unavaila.description: Alert when the service is turned off or no longer allows linking.

settings.linked_accounts.failed.expired.defaultMessage: The link took too long. Try again.
settings.linked_accounts.failed.expired.description: Alert when the link expired before the service sent the user back.

settings.linked_accounts.failed.rate_lim.defaultMessage: Too many attempts. Try again later.
settings.linked_accounts.failed.rate_lim.description: Alert when the user tried too many times.

settings.linked_accounts.failed.failed.defaultMessage: The service did not complete the sign-in. Try again.
settings.linked_accounts.failed.failed.description: Alert when the user cancelled at the service, or the service answered an error.

settings.external_confirmation.descripti.defaultMessage: Confirm that it is you by signing in again with a linked account.
settings.external_confirmation.descripti.description: Text above the buttons that confirm an operation (such as deleting the account) by signing in again at a linked service, for a user without a password and passkeys.

settings.external_confirmation.start.description: Button that leaves for a linked service to confirm an operation. {provider} is the service's name as the administrators wrote it.

settings.external_confirmation.confirmed.defaultMessage: You signed in again with {provider}. Finish within 10 minutes.
settings.external_confirmation.confirmed.description: Note once the user confirmed an operation at a linked service and came back. {provider} is the service's name.

settings.external_confirmation.start_fai.defaultMessage: The confirmation could not be started: {reason}
settings.external_confirmation.start_fai.description: Alert when starting a confirmation with a linked service failed. {reason} is the server's or the network's reason.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.mi.defaultMessage: You signed in with an account that is not linked to yours. Try again with your linked account.
settings.external_confirmation.failed.mi.description: Alert when the user confirmed at the service with another account than the linked one.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.ex.defaultMessage: The confirmation took too long or was already used. Try again.
settings.external_confirmation.failed.ex.description: Alert when the confirmation with a linked service expired (10 minutes) or was used.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.ra.defaultMessage: Too many attempts. Try again later.
settings.external_confirmation.failed.ra.description: Alert when the user failed to confirm too many times.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.un.description: Alert when the linked service is turned off.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.de.defaultMessage: That service does not accept the account you signed in with.
settings.external_confirmation.failed.de.description: Alert when the account at the service does not meet the administrators' conditions.

settings.external_confirmation.failed.fa.defaultMessage: The service did not confirm the sign-in. Try again.
settings.external_confirmation.failed.fa.description: Alert when the user cancelled at the service, the service answered an error, or it did not ask the user to sign in again.

settings.account.delete.confirm.descript.defaultMessage: Your account is deleted at once, and you are signed out. This cannot be undone.
settings.account.delete.confirm.descript.description: Description of the dialog that deletes the account of a user who confirmed by signing in again at a linked service.

settings.invites.title.description: Title of the settings page of the invites that the user created, and its item in the settings menu.

settings.invites.description.defaultMessage: Invite people you know to this server. Each invite has a link that lets a few people sign up for a while. While the server approves sign-ups by hand, the people you invite skip the wait.
settings.invites.description.description: Explanation at the top of the user's invites page.

settings.invites.new.title.description: Heading of the region of the form of a new invite on the user's invites page.

settings.invites.not_allowed.defaultMessage: You cannot create invites now. You can still copy the links of your usable invites and revoke them.
settings.invites.not_allowed.description: Shown instead of the form of a new invite when the user may not create invites: the server or their roles do not let them, their account is restricted, or the server takes no new accounts.

settings.invites.usage.defaultMessage: You have {usable, number} of {max, number} usable invites.
settings.invites.usage.description: How many usable invites the user holds, and how many the server lets one person hold at once.

settings.invites.full.defaultMessage: You have as many usable invites as you may. Revoke one, or wait until one expires or is used up, to create another.
settings.invites.full.description: Shown above the form of a new invite when the user already holds as many usable invites as the server allows.

settings.invites.max_uses.description: Label of the choice of how many people may sign up with a new invite.

settings.invites.max_uses.description.defaultMessage: How many people may sign up with the invite, up to {max, number}.
settings.invites.max_uses.description.description: Help of the number of sign-ups of a new invite. {max} is the most the server allows.

settings.invites.uses.description: An option of the number of sign-ups of a new invite.

settings.invites.expires_in.description: Label of the choice of how long a new invite works.

settings.invites.expires_in.description.defaultMessage: The invite stops working after this time, at most {max}.
settings.invites.expires_in.description.description: Help of how long a new invite works. {max} is the longest time the server allows, formatted like the options (for example "30 days").

settings.invites.duration.minutes.description: An option of how long an invite works, in minutes.

settings.invites.duration.hours.description: An option of how long an invite works, in hours.

settings.invites.duration.days.description: An option of how long an invite works, in days.

settings.invites.create.description: Button that creates a new invite on the user's invites page.

settings.invites.create_failed.description: Error when creating an invite failed. {reason} is the server's reason.

settings.invites.created.description: Status after the user created an invite. {code} is its code.

settings.invites.link.defaultMessage: Send this link to the people you invite:
settings.invites.link.description: Text before the sign-up link of a new invite.

settings.invites.list.title.description: Heading of the list of the user's invites.

settings.invites.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of the user's invites.

settings.invites.empty.description.defaultMessage: The invites you create are listed here with how they were used.
settings.invites.empty.description.description: Description of the empty list of the user's invites.

settings.invites.state.description: Term of an invite in the user's list: what it allows now.

settings.invites.state.usable.description: State of an invite that people may sign up with.

settings.invites.state.revoked.description: State of an invite that was revoked.

settings.invites.state.expired.description: State of an invite whose time ran out.

settings.invites.state.exhausted.description: State of an invite that as many people signed up with as it allows.

settings.invites.state.creator_ineligibl.defaultMessage: Not usable while you cannot invite
settings.invites.state.creator_ineligibl.description: State of the user's invite while the user may not create invites (their permission ended, or their account is restricted). It works again when they may.

settings.invites.used.description: Term of an invite in the user's list: how many people signed up with it.

settings.invites.used.value.description: How many people signed up with an invite, and how many it allows.

settings.invites.expires_at.description: Term of an invite in the user's list: when it stops working.

settings.invites.created_at.description: Term of an invite in the user's list: when it was created.

settings.invites.copy.description: Button that copies the sign-up link of an invite.

settings.invites.copy_invite.defaultMessage: Copy the link of the invite {code}
settings.invites.copy_invite.description: Accessible name of the copy button of an invite. {code} is its code.

settings.invites.copied.defaultMessage: Copied the link of the invite {code}.
settings.invites.copied.description: Toast after an invite's link was copied. {code} is its code.

settings.invites.copy_failed.defaultMessage: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy it yourself.
settings.invites.copy_failed.description: Toast when copying an invite's link failed.

settings.invites.revoke.description: Button that revokes an invite at once.

settings.invites.revoke_invite.description: Accessible name of the revoke button of an invite. {code} is its code; {date} when it was created, formatted.

settings.invites.revoked.defaultMessage: Revoked the invite {code}. The people who signed up with it keep their accounts.
settings.invites.revoked.description: Status after the user revoked an invite. {code} is its code.

settings.invites.revoke_failed.description: Toast when revoking an invite failed. {reason} is the server's reason.

settings.notifications.title.description: Title of the settings page of notifications (which notifications arrive in the app, by push, by email, and with a sound), and its entry in the settings menu.

settings.notifications.table.description.defaultMessage: Choose how each kind of notification reaches you. A kind turned off in the app is not created, so it does not arrive by push, email, or sound either; the notifications you already have stay. A checked box that cannot be changed is always on.
settings.notifications.table.description.description: Help text above the tables of the notification settings: turning a kind off in the app stops it everywhere, and disabled checked boxes are always on.

settings.notifications.section.ordinary.description: Heading of the table of the notifications about what other users did (mentions, follows, boosts...).

settings.notifications.section.moderator.description: Heading of the table of the notifications for moderators (reports, sign-ups, appeals...); shown only to users with those permissions.

settings.notifications.section.instance.description: Heading of the table of the server's notices to the user (moderation decisions, the closure of the server, the supporter plan).

settings.notifications.column.type.description: Header of the first column of the notification settings tables, which names the kind of notification of each row.

settings.notifications.channel.in_app.description: Column header of the notification settings tables: whether the notifications are created and shown in the app.

settings.notifications.channel.push.description: Column header of the notification settings tables: whether the notifications are pushed to this device (Web Push).

settings.notifications.channel.email.description: Column header of the notification settings tables: whether the notifications are sent by email.

settings.notifications.channel.sound.description: Column header of the notification settings tables: whether this device plays a sound when the notifications arrive while the app is open.

settings.notifications.cell.description: Accessible name of a checkbox of the notification settings tables. {type} is the row (a kind of notification), {channel} the column (In the app, Push, Email, Sound).

settings.notifications.group.mention.description: Row of the notification settings table: a post mentions the user.

settings.notifications.group.follow.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone followed the user.

settings.notifications.group.follow_requ.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone asked to follow the user.

settings.notifications.group.follow_acce.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone accepted the user's follow request.

settings.notifications.group.boost.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone boosted the user's post.

settings.notifications.group.favourite.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone favourited the user's post.

settings.notifications.group.reaction.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone reacted to the user's post with an emoji.

settings.notifications.group.quote.description: Row of the notification settings table: someone quoted the user's post.

settings.notifications.group.poll_closed.description: Row of the notification settings table: a poll the user made or voted in ended.

settings.notifications.group.account_mov.description: Row of the notification settings table: an account the user followed moved to another account.

settings.notifications.group.voice.description: Row of the notification settings table: an account the user follows opened a voice chat room, or the user was invited to one.

settings.notifications.group.admin_repor.description: Row of the notification settings table: (moderators) an account was reported.

settings.notifications.group.admin_sign_.description: Row of the notification settings table: (moderators) a registration awaits approval.

settings.notifications.group.admin_appea.description: Row of the notification settings table: (moderators) a user appealed a moderation action.

settings.notifications.group.admin_webho.description: Row of the notification settings table: (administrators) the server disabled a webhook that kept failing.

settings.notifications.group.admin_custo.description: Row of the notification settings table: (administrators) a user requested a custom emoji.

settings.notifications.group.admin_accou.description: Row of the notification settings table: (moderators) an account the moderators limit moved to another account.

settings.notifications.group.admin_servi.description: Row of the notification settings table: (administrators) the announced closing date of the server has passed.

settings.notifications.group.admin_error.description: Row of the notification settings table: (administrators) a new server error, or one that happened again.

settings.notifications.group.moderation.description: Row of the notification settings table: notices and decisions of the moderators about the user's account, appeals, reports and custom emoji requests, and follows ended by a suspension.

settings.notifications.group.service_clo.description: Row of the notification settings table: the closure of the service was announced, rescheduled or withdrawn.

settings.notifications.group.supporter.description: Row of the notification settings table: a failed payment for the user's supporter plan, its end, and its retirement. Not shown in the mobile app.

settings.notifications.sound.title.description: Heading of the section of the notification settings about the sound this device plays for new notifications.

settings.notifications.sound.enable.defaultMessage: Play a sound for new notifications
settings.notifications.sound.enable.description: Label of the switch that turns the notification sound on for this device.

settings.notifications.sound.enable.desc.defaultMessage: On this device, while the app is open. Choose the kinds in the Sound column of the tables below.
settings.notifications.sound.enable.desc.description: Help text of the switch of the notification sound; the Sound column appears in the tables while it is on.

settings.notifications.sound.play.description: Button that plays the notification sound once, which also lets the browser play it later.

settings.notifications.sound.blocked.defaultMessage: The browser did not play the sound. Allow this site to play sound in the browser's settings, then try again.
settings.notifications.sound.blocked.description: Error shown when the browser refused to play the notification sound after the user pressed the button.
